_README: Ground truth for the sample receipts, read off the images by eye. `null` means the total is not present in what Vision captured, so there is nothing to get right. `hard` marks a case we do not expect to pass and explains why, so a failure there is a known limit rather than a surprise. `date` is the document's own date; scoring reads it with today set to that date, as if photographed the same day, so the ±730-day sanity window does not mask the parser. `hard_date` marks a date we do not expect to get right, and says why.
